mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, we are looking at clear skies and a temperature of 66 degrees at Verona City Hall, but be aware of the elevated air quality index of 72. With a Waxing Gibbous moon overhead, we can expect a cool overnight low of 44 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

The city has launched several helpful initiatives, including a toilet rebate program to save water and the Eye-On-Water portal for residents to monitor their utility usage. Meanwhile, construction continues on Mark Drive, where underground utility work is complete and concrete work is currently underway.
Today, you can head to Hop Haus Brewing for trivia. Tomorrow, the local fun continues with more trivia at The Bogey Factory and Wednesday Pizza and a Pitcher at Wisconsin Brewing Company.

In a report from Thursday, October 15, the Verona Police Department successfully arrested a school bus driver for O W I following reports of erratic driving. No students were injured during the incident.
It is a great day to visit Culver's for the Devil's Food Cake flavor of the day. They are open until 10:00 PM, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
